Cost: 250eb (Expensive) for 1

One day, some Techie had an insane idea: What if grenades could fly and self-target like cruise missiles? Techtronika stole it immediately.

With an Action and 1 minute, this kit can turn a single non-hovering, non-Smart Grenade into a Homing version of itself, which consumes this kit. Homing Grenades cannot be loaded into Grenade Launchers.

When thrown, Homing Grenades hover in midair above the 2x2m/yds square it would’ve normally landed on. For the rest of the Round, it scans a 14x14m/yds (7x7 squares) area centered on itself while its onboard logic processor decides what target within this area it believes is the current largest threat to its user (allied or otherwise). This scan goes through transparent materials and obscurement (smoke, glass, darkness, etc), but cannot scan through ceilings or sealed vehicle roofs.

At the beginning of the next Round, the Homing Grenade flies directly at its chosen target and detonates as normal, flying above any Cover in its path. Dodging a Hover Grenade (by anyone able to dodge Explosives normally) requires beating a DV17 Evasion Check. While a Homing Grenade is hovering, it can be targeted as an Aimed Shot, and when hit by an Aimed Shot while hovering, detonates in midair harmlessly.

Stack: 1

Foundry notes:

  • Not loadable ammo: an adapter you apply to other rounds or grenades.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Ammunition).
